description:
Check a plan against the organisation as it is now: every check each item's own route would run. Changes nothing. Free.

With an API key, the checks against the organisation's people (who is a member, has an invitation, is a reviewer) are not run, and their paths are listed in 'unchecked'; apply runs them.

Needs an API key with the 'onboard' scope (#844), which is never on by default: an organisation admin or engineer ticks it on a new key (a key that had 'workflows' before #844 was given it). Without it the call fails naming the scope: ask a person for such a key rather than retrying.

Returns: { plan_id, revision, valid, problems: [{ path, code, message }] (at most 50), problems_total, operator_only: [paths only a HandInLoop operator applies], admin_only: [sections only an organisation admin applies], unchecked: [paths] }
name: handinloop_validate_onboarding_plan
title: Check an Onboarding Plan
